xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4970: Per-PR auto-merge and UAT batch generations race on the same PRs: 30 batches invalidated in a day, Merge batch button does nothing

plan.title: Per-PR auto-merge and UAT batch generations race on the same PRs: 30 batches invalidated in a day, Merge batch button does nothing
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Nine vertical items over one merge-ownership rule; 20 files across server services, lib/cloister, routes, frontend merge-train components and docs.

narratives.Problem: Two merge paths act on the same ready PRs. The per-PR auto-merge scheduler (auto-merge-scheduler.ts) schedules every unheld, gate-approved PR, while the UAT batch reconciler (uat-reconciler.ts) batches every approved, green, mergeable PR whether or not it is held. In the Overdeck project nothing is held (global require_uat_before_merge=false), so every batch member is also auto-merged, the member leaves the ready set, and the batch is invalidated: 30 generations on 2026-11-03. The Merge batch button on an invalidated card returns 409 wrong-status only after slow per-member forge reads, and the operator saw no message.
narratives.Proposal: Introduce one owner per ready feature: mergePathOwner (new services/merge-path-owner.ts) applies, first match wins: kill switch => batch; autoMergePolicyRefusal (held/closed/train off) => batch; Deft hold => batch; pending/merging row => per-pr; GitLab or polyrepo => batch; cancelled row => batch; failed/blocked row => per-pr only when latestAutoMergeAllowsSchedule says the scheduler can re-arm it for the current PR head; otherwise per-pr. It never writes pending_auto_merges. The reconciler takes it as an injected mergesPerPr dep and drops per-PR features before stale checks and assembly, invalidating any live batch that holds one with a distinct reason. The promote payload refuses a non-promotable generation before any forge read. The frontend toasts the reason and drops the stale card at once, and the queues payload marks per-PR items so the section says they merge one at a time instead of promising a batch. MergeTrainView.tsx is at the 1000-line ceiling, so an extraction item lands first. Docs state the one-owner rule.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing the auto-merge scheduler's skip logic or the auto-merge executor
- Hiding the Merge batch button for superseded generations (PROMOTABLE includes superseded on purpose)
- Storing an invalidation reason on the generation row
- Changing listReadyIssuesForProject or its other callers
- Per-row auto-merge badges on queue rows
- Raising any entry in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt
- Reproducing the original no-toast report in a live browser session

autoDecisions.summary: Partition by policy first and pending_auto_merges state second
autoDecisions.rationale: The scheduler and reconciler run on the same tick unordered; a state-only exclusion still assembles on tick N and invalidates on tick N+1. The policy rule is deterministic, and the pending-row check stays as a second guard for a feature scheduled before a hold-for-uat label.

autoDecisions.summary: The per-PR train counts as active only for GitHub, single-repo projects with OVERDECK_DISABLE_AUTO_MERGE unset
autoDecisions.rationale: The scheduler skips GitLab projects and the kill switch, and its gh pr list in a polyrepo wrapper path yields no PRs. Assigning those features to per-pr would leave them with no merge path at all.

autoDecisions.summary: Read labels through autoMergePolicyRefusal (cached tracker row), not issueHoldsForUat
autoDecisions.rationale: issueHoldsForUat runs one gh issue view per issue; calling it for every ready feature every 60 s costs N forge reads per tick and can disagree with the scheduler's cached read.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the Merge batch button for superseded generations
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for ready-only, but uat-promote.ts PROMOTABLE deliberately includes superseded (an older subset stays testable and promotable). The button already never renders for invalidated, failed or assembling rows; the real defect is a stale card, fixed by the promote-failure item.

autoDecisions.summary: Forced rebuild does not override per-PR ownership
autoDecisions.rationale: Force bypasses backoff and the live-match check, which are retry levers; ownership is policy, and batching a per-PR feature would restart the churn.

It already refuses every feature the owner rule assigns to batch (the owner rule mirrors its skip order). A batch member that gains the auto-merge label is the operator's explicit choice and invalidates its batch once.

items.title: Add mergePathOwner: one merge path owner per ready feature

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/services/merge-path-owner.ts exporting MergePathOwner ('per-pr' | 'batch'), MergePathOwnerDeps (env, forgeOf, latestAutoMerge, policyRefusal, deftHold, prOf), perPrTrainActiveForProject(projectPath, config, deps) and mergePathOwner(issueId, projectPath, config, deps), exactly as PRD item 1 and Decision 2 (revised after critique) specify. Rule order, first match wins: (1) env OVERDECK_DISABLE_AUTO_MERGE === '1' => batch; (2) autoMergePolicyRefusal(issueId) non-null => batch; (3) deftAutoMergeHold(issueId) non-null => batch; (4) newest getLatestAutoMerge row pending or merging => per-pr; (5) forgeForProject(projectPath) === 'gitlab' => batch; (6) config?.workspace?.type === 'polyrepo' => batch; (7) newest row cancelled => batch; (8) newest row failed or blocked => per-pr only when latestAutoMergeAllowsSchedule(row, { url, headSha }) from auto-merge-scheduler.ts is true for the current PR from prOf, else batch; (9) otherwise per-pr. prOf defaults to a lookup in the cached listRepoPullRequests(projectPath) listing (open row with headRefName feature/<id lower>, returning url and headRefOid). Defaults load through dynamic import (routes/merge-train.js must be dynamic). Upper-case the issue id. mergePathOwner calls perPrTrainActiveForProject for rules 1, 5, 6. The module never writes pending_auto_merges. Write merge-path-owner.test.ts with every dep injected, covering every rule and both handoff transitions.

items.title: Given an unheld feature in a GitHub monorepo with a newest pending or merging row, mergePathOwner returns 'per-pr', and returns 'per-pr' for the same row in a GitLab or polyrepo project

Given a pending row, mergePathOwner returns 'batch' when OVERDECK_DISABLE_AUTO_MERGE is '1', returns 'per-pr' for the same row once the switch is unset, and returns 'batch' when policyRefusal returns a 412 or deftHold returns a reason

Given no active row, mergePathOwner returns 'batch' for a GitLab forge, a polyrepo config, or a cancelled newest row, and returns 'per-pr' for a merged newest row or no row in an active GitHub monorepo

Given a newest failed row, mergePathOwner returns 'batch' when its headSha equals the current PR head from prOf or the row has no headSha, and returns 'per-pr' when the PR head changed; a blocked row at the same head returns 'per-pr'
